technique_name: Compare and contrast the English language and Mandarin.
description: English and Mandarin are two distinct languages with similarities and differences. English is an Indo-European language, consisting of a highly-developed vocabulary and an intricate spelling system. Mandarin is a Sino-Tibetan language with a tonal system, an abundance of loanwords, and a simplified writing system.
